claims.value: 목뼈 쪽 연결을 유지하면서 어깨뼈가 위로 올라가는 견갑거근의 대표 작용을 봅니다. 어깨뼈·빗장뼈와 연결된 팔의 문맥을 함께 관찰합니다.
교육용으로 작성한 짧은 대표 움직임입니다. 준비 구간과 선택 근육의 작용 구간을 구분하며 정상 가동범위나 힘을 계산하지 않습니다.
주변 근육과 뼈는 온전한 표면을 유지하며 함께 움직이거나 수동으로 변형됩니다. 개별 근육의 힘·활성도를 뜻하지 않습니다.

qualitativeDirectionEvidence.locator: Table 11.8, Trapezius row: shoulder/scapula elevation; the source does not assign the group action to a particular part

unresolved: Joint-end centroid is an authored approximation; articular pivot fitting/contact correction and actual scene QA required before registration.
Unlinked attachment contexts do not establish passive-tissue completeness.
Exact frame-0 source geometry, side-labelled source skeleton, source input SHA and pinned qualitative movement/action locator retained.
The ipsilateral clavicle, scapula, humerus, radius/ulna and distal chain share the authored pose only as passive skeletal context; it is not a claim of normal shoulder rhythm or muscle activation.

Girdle and trunk-to-humerus muscle masks are reproducible nearest-source-surface distance fields between exact source bone meshes. Endpoint pins are authored constraints, not measured attachment footprints or pivot/normal-axis data.
Muscle surfaces wholly within the co-moving limb chain follow the chain rigidly as passive context; this is not a muscle contraction demo.
Source-only, local technical use only, public redistribution held, human review not performed, and canonical binding absent.
